items.title: Experience the C-2A Greyhound and Its Legacy of Supporting the Fleet
items.description: Following the C-2A Greyhound’s retirement from service, the Patuxent River Naval Air Museum will host “Meet the Aircraft: C-2A Greyhound” on Sept. 26, 2026. The event will honor the aircraft’s decades-long role as a vital link between shore and aircraft carriers at sea, sustaining carrier operations and fleet readiness. items.title: Lyster Hits the Lanes for Suicide Prevention
items.description: FORT RUCKER, Ala. — Staff members from Lyster Army Health Clinic laced up their bowling shoes and hit the lanes during their lunch hour September 16, 2026 for a team bowling event held in recognition of Suicide Awareness and Prevention Month. The event offered staff an opportunity to step away from their daily clinical duties to foster camaraderie, strengthen peer connections, and engage in meaningful dialogue about mental health and wellness.
